create.name: Tallahassee Chan Center
create.bio:
Tallahassee Chan Center is a Chan Buddhist community in the Dharma Drum lineage of Master Sheng Yen, founded and guided by Guo Gu (Dr Jimmy Yu). It started in 2009 as a small sitting group that Guo Gu began as a way of repaying his gratitude to his late teacher, meeting in space shared with other Buddhist groups at Railroad Square in Tallahassee. The group became a branch of the Dharma Drum Mountain Buddhist Association in 2010 and a chapter in 2014, and in 2017 Guo Gu opened the present centre on a five-acre site on Paul Russell Road, which is wheelchair accessible and open to all.

The centre teaches the two classic Chan methods, silent illumination and huatou, and aims to make them usable in modern life across religious lines. Each week brings evening and Sunday sittings, in person and on Zoom, offered on a dana basis, with Dharma talks, walking meditation and mindful yoga, plus individual interviews with assistant teachers appointed by Guo Gu. A seven-day intensive closes each year, and a month-long summer residency combines a study workshop with a ten-day retreat. Recorded series on the Heart Sutra, the Vimalakirti Sutra, precepts and Bodhidharma's teachings are free to stream, and the centre also runs a prison correspondence programme and a lending library.

courses.title: 7-Day Intensive Chan Retreat (In Person and Online)
courses.description: The centre's year-end week of intensive Chan practice with daily Dharma talks by Guo Gu: half-hour sitting periods alternating with mindful yoga and walking meditation, open to either method, silent illumination or huatou. Join on site, with lodging, camping or commuting, or online by Zoom.

courses.title: Chan Summer Residency Program '27
courses.description: A four-week in-person residency with Guo Gu centred on a Huayan meditation text on bodhicitta: a fourteen-day study workshop followed by a ten-day retreat, which can also be booked separately. Applications run until 10 January 2027.
courses.price: Supported: Commuting $1,360, Camping $1,440, Lodging $1,720; Regular: Commuting $1,700, Camping $1,800, Lodging $2,150; Sustainer: Commuting $2,000, Camping $2,100, Lodging $2,450 (4-week program)

free_resources.title: Dharma Talks
free_resources.description: Guo Gu's recorded talk series for streaming or download, including commentaries on the Heart Sutra, the Vimalakirti Sutra, Bodhidharma's Two Entrances and Four Practices, huatou, precepts and guided meditation.
